about: Generated by scripts/build_lookalike_crosscheck.py from src/localvault/lookalike.py. pairs: [origin index, saved index, kind, matched saved index or -1, reason] for classify(origin, [saved]); lists: [origin index, kind, matched saved index or -1, reason] for classify(origin, all saved). shield_pairs: the pairs whose phishing-shield verdict (lookalike.classify, which keeps related for the same host or its www twin) differs, same layout; shield_lists: the shield verdict against all saved, same layout as lists.
